create_article.description: Publish an article on the site, such as news from a form, a document or an AI step, in a category with tags, now or at a time you choose.

parameters.description: The article's title.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: What the article says, in the format chosen.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: The language it's in, for a site in several languages. Defaults to all languages.

parameters.description: A sentence or two for search engines to show.

parameters.description: A name to show as its author instead of yours, such as the person who sent it in.

create_user.description: Add a user to the site, such as a member who signed up. Joomla emails them their username and password, unless the site turned that off.
